statusDetail: All 58 catalog checks were judged. The live deployment currently serves index HTML for hashed assets, causing a blank SPA; a successful Lighthouse snapshot also supplied evidence about the last renderable build.

page.notes: Public Peruvian election-results SPA. Global asset delivery failure prevented meaningful route traversal in raw-CDP sessions; Lighthouse obtained one successful mobile render of /main/resumen, so both failure-state and rendered-build evidence were judged.

paths.description: Public entry route and bootstrap/primary-results journey. Tested desktop, mobile, dark preference, reduced motion, no-JS crawler, network, security and memory baseline. Represents the shared Angular shell.

Direct /main/resumen results route, selected as the primary detail/dashboard archetype. Raw-CDP remained blank; Lighthouse captured a successful mobile render. Other result/filter subroutes were not covered because the global asset failure prevented navigation and they share this shell.

findings.summary: The election-results application is currently a blank page, so its primary task cannot be completed.
findings.evidence: Repeated desktop and mobile screenshots, DOM probes after 20 seconds, and direct requests show an empty <app-root>. Hashed JS, CSS and image URLs return the 16,591-byte index HTML with content-type text/html and CloudFront x-cache: Error, so the SPA cannot mount.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the deployed hashed assets and configure the SPA fallback to serve index.html only for navigation requests, never for static asset paths. Add deployment smoke tests that assert JS/CSS MIME types and non-empty rendered results.

findings.summary: No purpose, result, or next action is visible in the live page.
findings.evidence: The 20-second evaluate probe reports empty body text, zero headings, zero links, zero buttons and an empty app-root.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a server-delivered heading and status/results summary before hydration, with a clear route to detailed results.

findings.summary: Asset failure produces no loading, error, retry, or fallback state.
findings.evidence: After 20 seconds the viewport remains blank and contains no recovery control or status message.
findings.suggestedFix: Ship a static app-shell error boundary with timeout detection, useful status text, and a retry plus alternate official-results link.

findings.summary: Core election results are unavailable without successful JavaScript execution.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML contains only an empty app-root; crawler evidence reports three raw content tokens and no h1, while the current JS assets fail to load as executable JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the election summary and navigation, then hydrate enhancements. Keep meaningful content and links in the initial HTML.

findings.summary: The runtime has a single point of failure at application bootstrap.
findings.evidence: Both / and /main/resumen remain empty when the hashed bundles are unavailable; no runtime shell survives.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a non-JavaScript fallback and bootstrap error boundary that remains outside the Angular mount and can report/retry failures.

findings.summary: Network and deployment failures collapse to a blank screen.
findings.evidence: Static asset failures are returned as HTTP 200 HTML and the page gives no failure state after 20 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Return correct 404/5xx statuses for missing assets and render actionable network/error states with retry and last-known results.

findings.summary: The last successful Lighthouse render was slow: LCP 12.7 s and FCP 4.9 s.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 12,722 ms, FCP 4,874 ms, CLS 0.094 and TBT 72 ms, scoring performance 0.60. Current raw-CDP traces cannot paint the broken app at all.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the result heading/LCP content, remove bootstrap dependency chains, and server-render initial results. Re-test LCP under representative mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is globally hidden.
findings.evidence: The global rule * { outline: 0 !important } removes focus indication from all controls; Lighthouse also found an unnamed menu button.
findings.suggestedFix: Delete the blanket outline rule and provide a high-contrast :focus-visible ring without removing native fallback focus.

findings.summary: The successful render had no main landmark, and focus visibility is removed globally.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse landmark-one-main failed; captured CSS sets outline:0!important on every element.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary results in <main>, preserve a logical heading order, and restore visible keyboard focus.

findings.summary: Static assets are unsafely deployed and several images lack intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: JS/CSS/SVG paths currently return HTML. Lighthouse also flagged five unsized images, creating layout-shift risk.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix asset routing/MIME types and set width/height or aspect-ratio on every image.

findings.summary: Core navigation and content are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML has no content links; Lighthouse found a pseudoLink anchor without href, and /robots.txt returns the SPA HTML with 52 syntax errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href values for navigation and publish a valid text/plain robots.txt.

findings.summary: Static delivery is misconfigured and useful cache headers are absent on hashed assets.
findings.evidence: HAR hygiene flags missing cache headers for hashed JS/font assets; direct asset responses return index HTML instead of the requested MIME type.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve immutable hashed assets with correct MIME types and Cache-Control: public,max-age=31536000,immutable; reserve no-cache for index.html.

findings.summary: The successful build shipped substantial unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 629 KiB unused JavaScript, including 517 KiB from main and about 127 KiB across GTM/gtag, plus 37 KiB unused CSS (90%).
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split the Angular application, remove unused CSS, and load analytics only after consent/idle where justified.

findings.summary: The page has no system-driven dark theme.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark the blank surface remains #f8f8f8; computed color-scheme is normal and the CSS contains no dark-mode media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and define semantic surface/text tokens under prefers-color-scheme, ensuring the results view remains legible.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference is not handled.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched reduce but found no prefers-reduced-motion CSS; global scroll-behavior remains smooth.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable smooth scrolling and non-essential motion under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Global CSS suppresses focus outlines and contains no high-contrast adaptation.
findings.evidence: The rendered CSS applies outline:0!important to every element; no forced-colors/prefers-contrast rule was found and computed outlines are none.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the global outline reset and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast styles that preserve native control boundaries and focus indicators.

findings.summary: The menu toggle lacks an accessible name.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse button-name identifies button#sidebarToggle with no visible text, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the toggle an explicit accessible name such as aria-label="Abrir menú" and update it when expanded.

findings.summary: The application emits CSP and fetch errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console records blocked region1.analytics.google.com connections and failed analytics fetches caused by CSP.
findings.suggestedFix: Either remove the unneeded analytics requests or align a deliberately narrow CSP with the exact endpoint; do not leave repeated blocked requests in production.

findings.summary: The title exists but the page has no meta description.
findings.evidence: DOM has title ONPE - PRESENTACIÓN DE RESULTADOS and no meta[name=description]; Lighthouse meta-description failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise Spanish description naming the 2026 second-round election results and ONPE.

findings.summary: Canonical, sitemap and valid robots signals are absent.
findings.evidence: The SEO probe found no canonical; /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt both return index HTML with status 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid robots.txt and sitemap.xml, add a canonical URL, and return correct content types/statuses.

findings.summary: Analytics cookies are missing Secure and use SameSite=None for 400 days; CSP also permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found _ga and _ga_THMBN2T4BS without Secure, both SameSite=None and 400-day expiry. Header audit flags unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Set analytics cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite policy and shorter retention; migrate scripts/styles to nonces or hashes and remove unsafe-eval.

findings.summary: Tracking dominates the network before any useful result appears.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 9/15 requests and 289,128/316,075 transferred bytes third-party (91.5%); tracker audit identifies GTM and DoubleClick.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit whether each analytics/advertising endpoint is necessary for a public election-results service, gate non-essential tracking on consent, and batch/minimize collection.

findings.summary: Most transferred bytes and much of the shipped code do not support the visible task.
findings.evidence: Third-party analytics accounts for 91.5% of captured bytes, while Lighthouse estimates 629 KiB unused JS and 37 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or defer non-essential trackers, code-split routes and eliminate unused CSS/JS.

findings.summary: The third-party budget is disproportionate to a public results page.
findings.evidence: GTM/gtag transferred 288,557 bytes while the current app showed no content; known trackers include GTM and DoubleClick.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party byte/request budget and load only essential, privacy-reviewed analytics after core content.

findings.summary: The app has no manifest, service-worker controller, or offline fallback.
findings.evidence: The page probe found no manifest URL and sw=false.
findings.suggestedFix: For this public results app, add a manifest and a service worker that caches the shell and most recently viewed published results, with an explicit stale/offline label.

findings.summary: The CSS evidence shows viewport breakpoints but no component/container responsiveness.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS includes max-width media queries while computed container-type is normal and no @container rule appears in captured CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container-type and @container for reusable result cards, filters and navigation modules that appear at different widths.

findings.summary: Production debugging and inspector hygiene are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports the large main bundle has no source map and records CSP inspector issues; BFCache itself passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish restricted production source maps to error tooling and resolve CSP inspector violations.

findings.summary: Election-result pages expose no structured data or social preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The SEO probe found zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and appropriate schema.org Dataset/GovernmentOrganization JSON-LD matching visible results.

findings.summary: Modern navigation/interaction guidance is not implemented for this results SPA.
findings.evidence: No View Transition API usage or transition evidence is present; navigation either fails or swaps without a rendered continuity cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the mapped declarative platform primitive where the interaction exists, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Modern navigation/interaction guidance is not implemented for this results SPA.
findings.evidence: The long results experience provides no evidenced scroll-state-aware chrome or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the mapped declarative platform primitive where the interaction exists, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.evidence: The successful Lighthouse DOM shows an Angular Material menu trigger, with no native popover/CSS anchor positioning evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the mapped declarative platform primitive where the interaction exists, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.suggestedFix: Use the mapped declarative platform primitive where the interaction exists, with reduced-motion fallback.
